title: Pronouns — Personal
subtitle: Thou versus ye — the great social divide.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.
Prepare for sustained reading in Stage 3.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Thou (singular, intimate or inferior) versus ye (plural or formal singular). The great shift from thou to you happens after Chaucer. Hir (their) and hem (them) come from Old Norse; Old English would have used hira and him. The pronoun system is in transition.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.
